narrative: A paring-knife and a closed book on the kitchen board, beside a cloth with one corner of pie still in it. Apple-light from the open door, and a wasp on the rim of the jug. No one is in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not sit down to the board.
